verification_policy: Distinguish verified access descriptions from unverified GPS coordinates. Set coordinate verification to needs_review wherever exact entrance or sidewalk-point coordinates have not been independently established. Centroids and road intersections are not entrances. Do not invent or estimate replacement coordinates.

access_points.supporting_evidence: Official Grand Central visitor address (89 E 42nd St) and primary monumental south entrance portals on East 42nd St under the Park Ave Viaduct, providing direct pedestrian access to the Main Concourse. Exact GPS door coordinates require independent field or surveyor verification.
access_points.source_type: Official venue visitor information and municipal landmark designation
access_points.notes: Main public entrance retained at 89 E 42nd St. Connects directly to the East 42nd Street sidewalk and pedestrian crossings opposite Pershing Square.

access_points.supporting_evidence: Official NYPL visitor and accessibility guidance identifies 10 West 42nd Street as the dedicated accessible ramp entrance connecting to the ground-floor Visitor Center and elevators. Former attribution of OSM node 1634448982 to this entrance is unsupported and retracted. Existing coordinates represent the building search anchor / 5th Ave frontage and are flagged needs_review until the 42nd St entrance pin is surveyed.
access_points.source_type: Official NYPL visitor location and accessibility guide
access_points.notes: 10 West 42nd Street is the designated step-free accessible entrance on the north facade.

access_points.street_address: Mid-block West 40th and West 42nd Streets (between Fifth and Sixth Avenues), New York, NY 10018
access_points.supporting_evidence: Official Bryant Park Corporation accessibility guidelines specify that accessible public park entrances are located mid-block on West 40th Street and West 42nd Street (between 5th and 6th Aves), with vehicle drop-off at 35 W 40th St. The previous northwest corner gate claim is replaced with these official accessible entrance descriptions. The current coordinates reflect the perimeter corner and require survey adjustment to exact mid-block gate positions.
access_points.source_type: Bryant Park Corporation official accessibility and park access guide
access_points.notes: Park grounds are open daily (07:00-23:00); accessible entrances mid-block on W 40th and W 42nd Streets.

access_points.supporting_evidence: Official visitor entrance for SUMMIT One Vanderbilt observatory is located at 45 E 42nd St (between Vanderbilt and Madison Avenues). Additional official public access points include the Transit Hall entrance at the corner of Vanderbilt Avenue and 43rd Street, and direct indoor access from the Grand Central Terminal Main Concourse level. The private corporate office lobby at 1 Vanderbilt Avenue is excluded from public access. The street coordinates for 45 E 42nd St require independent pedestrian pin verification.
access_points.source_type: Official SUMMIT One Vanderbilt visitor arrival guide and transit agreements
access_points.notes: Includes 45 E 42nd St, Vanderbilt Ave & 43rd St Transit Hall, and Grand Central Main Concourse connection.

access_points.supporting_evidence: Commercial office building with restricted tenant interior access. Recommended pedestrian approach is from the public Pershing Square pedestrian plaza and sidewalk along East 42nd Street and Park Avenue. Plaza coordinate pin remains unverified by independent survey.
access_points.notes: Exterior architectural viewing point situated on the north sidewalk of 42nd St / Pershing Square Plaza.

access_points.supporting_evidence: Iconic commercial office tower with private/restricted interior tenancy. The public viewing access is from the exterior sidewalk along Lexington Avenue and East 42nd Street. Sidewalk vantage point coordinates have not been independently surveyed.
access_points.notes: Provides unobstructed street-level view of the Art Deco tower and crown.

access_points.access_name: Lexington Avenue Graybar Portal Viewing Point

access_points.supporting_evidence: Commercial office skyscraper with private tenant spaces. Architectural interest focuses on the exterior bronze terra-cotta relief friezes along East 42nd Street and Lexington Avenue. Sidewalk viewing coordinate remains unverified.
access_points.source_type: LPC presentation materials and NRHP nomination 80002676
access_points.notes: Exterior architectural viewing point located on the south sidewalk of East 42nd Street.

access_points.access_name: East 42nd Street Exterior & Entrance Viewing Point
access_points.supporting_evidence: Office building with renowned Raymond Hood Art Deco facade and landmarked lobby globe. Interior public access varies according to building security; the primary reliable public access is exterior approach along the south sidewalk of East 42nd Street. Sidewalk coordinates have not been independently established.
access_points.source_type: LPC designation materials, Docomomo US register, and NRHP 82001191
access_points.notes: Situated on East 42nd Street between Second and Third Avenues.
